name: Sprinkle's Secret Ingredient
summary: After Marin Noggenfogger's brew turns out foul, Sprinkle in Gadgetzan offers to make it edible with her secret ingredient, a mushroom called the Violet Tragan. It grows underwater in a small lake in the Hinterlands.

sections.title: A Cook's Secret
sections.body: Sprinkle tells of her childhood, when her sister did all the cooking and the results were hard to stomach. Then she found a mushroom, the Violet Tragan, her "secret" ingredient, and it made every dish taste wonderful. She will use it to help turn Marin's horrid brew into something drinkable.

sections.title: Under the Water
sections.body: The mushroom is found in the Hinterlands, in a small lake there. Valorwind Lake lies just south of the road that crosses the zone. The Violet Tragan grows only underwater, so you will have to dive beneath the surface to gather it before returning to Sprinkle in Gadgetzan.

faq.answer: Sprinkle is a cook in Gadgetzan and a friend of Marin Noggenfogger, who sent you to her with a bad-tasting brew.
It is a mushroom Sprinkle found as a child and calls her secret ingredient. She says it makes anything taste great.

faq.q: Where can the Violet Tragan be found?
faq.answer: Only underwater, in a small lake in the Hinterlands. Valorwind Lake lies just south of the road across the zone.

faq.q: How does this connect to Marin Noggenfogger?
faq.answer: Marin's brew tasted terrible, so Sprinkle wants the Violet Tragan to turn it into something edible.
